name: bright-paper-collage
title_zh: 亮色纸拼贴画风提示词，海报封面分镜一稿齐
tagline_zh: 要亮色纸拼贴/半调剪纸风，却总被AI画成廉价贴纸？这套提示词自带光影层次与纸张肌理，海报、封面、分镜。
tagline_en: Tired of AI turning bright paper collage into cheap stickers? These prompts bake in lighting depth and paper.
desc_en: Compile exactly the requested poster, cover, still, keyframe, infographic, B-roll, image-to-video, layout/code, or custom asset-generation prompt in an adaptive premium bright paper-collage design language. Use when the user names bright-paper-collage, asks for bright paper collage or halftone paper-cut styling, or a workflow needs a prompt in this design system. The skill returns prompts only and
why_zh: 不靠形容词堆砌，而是用结构化的纸张层叠、裁切边缘与半调网点参数，让模型稳定输出有物理质感的拼贴。
why_en: No adjective soup—structured layering, cut-edge, and halftone parameters force physical collage depth instead of flat sticker.
limit_zh: 只产出提示词文本，不生成图像；需配合支持超长提示的绘图模型（如Midjourney/SDXL）。不覆盖暗色。
limit_en: Outputs prompts only, no images. Needs a model with long prompt support (Midjourney/SDXL). No dark, vintage, or realistic collage—strays outside.
title_en: Bright paper-collage prompts for posters, covers.
